Individual reference asset parts consistent with hero geometry as much as possible. All shared modules honor same kit shapes across designs: square slightly tapered straight post, thick rectangular straight beam, flat rectangular wall infill, thick olive roof plank with sparse sculpted chamfer, square foundation block. Characteristic curved front post reserved unique bake rather than universal stretched trim.
